hints.title: Difference Array Boundary Marking
hints.text: Instead of incrementing every position in the range, record the increment at startIdx and negate it right after endIdx.

hints.title: Single Prefix Sum Integration
hints.text: A cumulative running sum over the difference array recovers the actual modified value at each index.

hints.title: Difference Array Construction and Scan
hints.text: Allocate array of size length plus one with zeros. For update start, end, inc, add inc to diff[start] and subtract inc from diff[end+1]. Accumulate prefix sum over range length to produce final array.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def getModifiedArray(self, length: int, updates: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        arr = [0] * (length + 1)
        for s, e, inc in updates:
            arr[s] += inc
            arr[e + 1] -= inc
        res = [0] * length
        running = 0
        for i in range(length):
            running += arr[i]
            res[i] = running
        return res
```

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(K + N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Applying each update eagerly requires O(K * N) operations, timing out for frequent updates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Difference array reduces range operations to O(1) endpoints, assembling the final array via a single O(N) prefix sum.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize standard difference array mechanics and avoid out-of-bounds access on end+1.
